decisions.briefing: Markets eased slightly today, with the NASDAQ down 0.7% and the S&P 500 down 0.4%, a neutral session without a clear direction. Cash is $445.88, below the $500 buy threshold, so I am holding all seven positions and not forcing a new buy. SKWD and TRAX passed all four momentum checks and are the top picks for the next strong up day.

market_education.summary_en: Stocks drifted modestly lower today, and the tech-heavy NASDAQ fell more than the broader S&P 500. Several large chip names were weak, NVDA among them with an RSI near 28, which pulled the tech index down. No news headlines came with today's data, so this explanation uses price and momentum data only and cites no sources.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日美股窄幅偏軟，以科技股為主的納指跌幅大於標普500。大型晶片股表現疲弱，其中NVDA的RSI跌至約28，拖累科技指數。由於今日數據未附新聞標題，以上分析僅根據價格及動能數據，並無引用新聞來源。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Cash drag is the small loss in returns from holding uninvested cash instead of putting it to work. Today we hold $445.88 in cash, which is less than the $500 minimum for a new buy, so a little of the portfolio sits idle. On a flat or slightly down day, that idle cash costs very little, and it gives us money ready to use when a stronger buying chance comes.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「現金拖累」是指持有未投資的現金，而非將資金投入市場所造成的輕微回報損失。今日組合持有445.88美元現金，低於新建倉所需的500美元門檻，因此有小部分資金暫時閒置。在大市持平或輕微下跌的日子，閒置現金的代價很小，反而能保留資金，待出現更強的買入機會時運用。
